title: docs(skills): objectui i18n guide keys the built-in packs by platform locale tag (zh-Hans, zh-Hant, pt-BR)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xE9wgHWTh9Jrvm1WVhqbLKh)_

Fixes #30911
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`skills/objectui/guides/i18n.md` 不再教已退役的 `zh` / `pt` 语言包键：内置语言改为平台语言表 `PLATFORM_LOCALES` 的 11 个标签（`en`、`zh-Hans`、`zh-Hant`、`es`、`ar`、`fr`、`pt-BR`、`ru`、`de`、`ja`、`ko`）及模块路径 `@object-ui/i18n/locales/<tag>`；setup 示例改用 `'zh-Hans'` 键；语言切换器改为遍历 `PLATFORM_LOCALES`，不再手写列表，且以 `resolveBuiltInLanguage(language) ?? language` 选中当前语言（实例以已存别名如 `zh` 运行时也能选中）；说明已存的 `zh` / `zh-CN` / `zh-TW` / `pt` 经语言表的读别名（`resolveBuiltInLanguage`）继续解析。
- **为什么改**：PR #30902 已把内置包从 `zh` / `pt` 改名为 `zh-Hans` / `pt-BR` 并新增 `zh-Hant`，照旧指南写的键和 import 在 `main` 上不再解析，也提供不了繁体中文。
- **风险与回滚**：只改 skill 文本和一个 changeset；token 天花板不动（1411/1413）；回滚即 revert，无运行时影响。
- **先看**：指南的「Built-in locales」段与切换器示例，对照 `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/registry.ts` 和 `packages/spec/src/system/platform-locales.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期 exit 0，`skills/objectui/guides/i18n.md` 读数 1411/1413。
- **需要你做的**：`skills/**` 属 Tier H，需要 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 批准。

## What changes

Every tag, path and alias the guide now states was read on `main` (`3fe5f2a02`, after PR #30902 at `5bca14fc`):

| Taught | Source on `main` |
|:--|:--|
| The eleven pack keys, in table order | `packages/spec/src/system/platform-locales.ts` `ROWS`; `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/registry.ts` `LAZY_LOCALE_LOADERS` (typed on `PlatformLocaleTag`) and `BUILT_IN_LANGUAGE_CODES`; `locales/index.ts` `builtInLocales` ("there is no `zh` or `pt` key") |
| Module `@object-ui/i18n/locales/<tag>` | `ui/packages/i18n/package.json` export `./locales/*`; after `pnpm build`, `dist/locales/zh-Hans.js`, `zh-Hant.js`, `pt-BR.js` (+ `.d.ts`) exist |
| Stored `zh` / `zh-CN` → `zh-Hans`, `zh-TW` → `zh-Hant`, `pt` → `pt-BR` | `PLATFORM_LOCALE_READ_ALIASES`, read by `resolveBuiltInLanguage` (`registry.ts`) through `platformLocaleTagOf` |
| "Write the tag" | `platform-locales.ts`: read aliases are "Reads only: a new write uses the table tag itself" |
| Switcher fed by `PLATFORM_LOCALES` (`tag`, `label`) | `PlatformLocale` interface, exported from `@objectstack/spec/system` |
| Switcher `value={resolveBuiltInLanguage(language) ?? language}` | An instance can run in a stored alias (`zh` from a stored choice via `resolveBootstrapConfig`, a seeded `zh-CN` via `resolveSeedLanguage`); `resolveBuiltInLanguage` is exported from the package entry (`ui/packages/i18n/src/index.ts`) |

The switcher fence is `os:check`-marked and compiles against the built types: `pnpm --dir ui run check:skill-examples` exit 0, `--list` shows `i18n.md:38 marked pass` (the `@objectstack/spec/system` import resolves). The unmarked setup fence's only `--measure` error is the pre-existing `AppContent` fragment name; the `'zh-Hans'` key type-checks.

The inline-map section (L133 on) is untouched: its `zh-CN` keys are still valid inline-map keys and it needs no `zh-Hant` example to stay correct.

**Evals swept:** `skills/objectui/evals/i18n.json` has no case grading a `zh` / `pt` pack key or path. Its one `zh` string, `must_not_contain: "import zh from './zh.json'"`, grades an app's own JSON import, not the retired built-in key, so it is left as is.

## Token budget

`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: `skills/objectui/guides/i18n.md` **1413 → 1411** (5652 → 5643 bytes; ceiling 1413, unchanged, headroom 2). Bundle total 228257 → 228255. No ratchet raise; `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is not touched.

Growth paid by deleting restatement in the same file, each with its surviving home:

1. L3 intro "Multi-language support via `@object-ui/i18n`." Home: the H1 and every fence's `import … from '@object-ui/i18n'` (first at Setup).
2. The Setup comment `// Auto-detect from navigator` on `detectBrowserLanguage: true`. Home: the option's own name (and its doc on `I18nConfig.detectBrowserLanguage` in `ui/packages/i18n/src/i18n.ts`).
3. The RTL section's fence `const { direction } = useObjectTranslation(); // direction: 'ltr' | 'rtl'`. Home: the useObjectTranslation hook example, which destructures `direction` and applies it (`<header dir={direction}>`); the RTL prose ("The provider updates `document.dir`…") stays.
4. Common mistakes bullet "Bundling all locale files upfront — use lazy loading for apps with many languages." Home: § Lazy language loading ("For large apps, load translations on demand instead of bundling all locales").
5. (review S1 payment) The § Language-aware + responsive page intro "When combining with `@object-ui/mobile` for responsive layouts:". Home: the section heading ("responsive page") and the fence's `import { useBreakpoint } from '@object-ui/mobile'`.

Review round 1 (contract review PASS at `291ef83d8`, comment 6694588461): S1 fixed in delta commit `450d72405`. The switcher's controlled `value` now resolves a stored alias to its table tag, so an instance running in `zh` or `zh-CN` selects 简体中文 instead of falling to the first option. Its +60 bytes are paid by deletion 5. The out-of-scope LocaleSwitcher finding is removed from this body: the seat files it as its own card.

## Review tier

`dispatch-gates` mandates the contract-review tier for `skills/**` (clause ①); waived by the maintainer's standing order in this project (2026-11-03). The seat runs the contract review.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on head `450d72405` (2 paths vs merge base `9d939c582`): **45 commands** (the same list as round 1), each run under `timeout 900` with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192` (raised from the cloud container default heap), exit code captured before any pipe → **45 × exit 0**. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` first exited 3 (NOT MEASURED: the spec build predated the rebase onto `9d939c582`); after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` it exited 0, and that is the recorded code. `--ran` reconciliation: `45 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 45 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. Extra, not derived but run by CI (`ci.yml`): `pnpm --dir ui run check:skill-examples` → exit 0 after the spec rebuild; `--list` shows `i18n.md:38 marked pass` with the new import. Round 1 at `291ef83d8` was also 45 × exit 0 after a full `pnpm build` (119/119). `origin/main` has since gained `e396095b6` (`ui/packages/types` only, disjoint), so no merge was needed. `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` → exit 0 before each push.
